design_detail: higher taxes on wealth; a minimum tax on the super-rich as an early protocol of the UN tax convention
quote_original: the richest individuals and corporations will pay their fair share through higher taxes on wealth, inheritance, and capital gains
source_title: "It's Time to Tax Power": ICRICT's message at the Vatican
grading_note: Her own words, quoted in the organiser's release; names higher taxes on wealth and floats a minimum tax on the super-rich, without a rate or threshold. Said at the Vatican event, not in a Senegalese forum.
